sections.question: By how many percentage points did EOG's cash, as a percentage of its total debt, rise from December 31, 2019 to June 30, 2026? Round to one decimal place.
sections.reasoning:
Step 1. Doc 1 (March 16, 2020): at December 31, 2019 the net debt reconciliation shows "Current and Long-Term Debt (GAAP) - (b)" of 5,175 and cash of 2,028 (in millions); the release text rounds these to "$5.2 billion" of total debt and "$2.0 billion" of cash. 2,028 / 5,175 = 39.19%.
Step 2. Doc 7: at June 30, 2026 the same reconciliation shows "Current and Long-Term Debt (GAAP) - (b)" of 7,926 and cash of 4,907 (in millions). 4,907 / 7,926 = 61.91%.
Step 3. Doc 1 and Doc 7: 61.91% - 39.19% = 22.7 percentage points (to one decimal place).
